items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: when he was playing drums I think Gilbert Young was the one who got me with the band.

ctx.x: Was Keith going bad or why did he stop trombone, do you know?

Well no I don't know why he stopped trombone but when he was playing drums I think Gilbert Young was the one who got me with the band. Gilbert Young and Emma Barrett the bell girl, she was playing piano and Feliks Goff was playing tenor saxophone because sometime Mr. Porter, Feliks would take a solo on a clap and Mr. Porter grab his tenor saxophone and he'd be playing and let it blow by and you know one of them kind of things. He could play at saxophone too you know Mr. Porter. Yeah. And we'd travel around…
I was going to ask one more question about Ridgely, did they both call it the Tuxedo Band? Is there any trouble about that? Yeah.
